definition: זוּן verb feed (Late Hebrew Biblical Aramaic id. ; Syriac ; Samaritan , ); — Hoph`al Participle סוּסִים מוזנים Jer 5:8 ( Kt ; i.e. מוּזָנִים ; Qr מְיֻזָּנִים from יזן q. v.) well-fed horses , figurative of adulterers; Dl Pr 73 f. compare Assyrian zanânu , be full (i.e. of sexual desire).
